integrity: A complete exact 96-assignment base certificate and an unbounded mathematical induction; independently reproducible code, with finite corroboration at m=3,4.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for complete tripartite graphs \(K_{2,m,n}\) with \(2\le m\le n\). Earlier small cases are credited; possible alternative prior amplification literature remains a risk. No independent audit.
title: Stable chromatic number of the two-by-variable complete tripartite family
